declarations.raw_header:
theorem selectRunWith_median_value (d cutoff : Nat) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff)
    (xs : List α) :
    (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc (((xs.length ⌈/⌉ d) - 1) / 2)
      (chunkMediansRun d xs).1).1 = medianOfMedians d xs
declarations.intended_claim: The observed recursive median selection of the unchanged generic worker equalsmedianOfMedians(d,xs), including optionalemptybehavior.
declarations.domain_and_quantifiers: Everyd≥2, cutoff≥1 andlinearlyordered payload list; no nonempty, distinctness orcost premise.
declarations.statement_and_proof_assessment: The existing actualvalue law andmeasuredmedianmap correspondence give the mathematicallower median before anycost induction.
declarations.case_connection: Repeated inputs for2/3/4/5/6 andempty payload;used toderive actualpivot membership inU proof.

declarations.raw_header:
theorem chunkMediansRun_proper_size (d : Nat) (xs : List α)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hx : 1 < xs.length) :
    0 < (chunkMediansRun d xs).1.length ∧
      (chunkMediansRun d xs).1.length < xs.length
declarations.intended_claim: The actualmedian-list length ispositive andstrictly less than theparentlength.
declarations.statement_and_proof_assessment: Nonemptiness follows from thecheckednil characterization; theexactceiling count isatmostn-1 bypositive-denominator arithmetic. No balance orcost assumption.
declarations.case_connection: Allrecursive cases havecutoff≥1 andn>cutoff; group2/smallcutoff isexplicitly exercised.

declarations.raw_header:
theorem selectRunWith_local_cost_bound (d : Nat) (xs : List α) (p : α) :
    1 + (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun xs).2 + (chunkMediansRun d xs).2 +
      (Partition.partitionRun p xs).2 + (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (partition3 p xs).1).2 +
      (SymmetricCosts.lengthRun (partition3 p xs).2.1).2 ≤
        tollCoefficient d * xs.length + 7
declarations.domain_and_quantifiers: Every naturald, everylist andeverypivot. At d0 this isonlyan auxiliarylocaloperation bound; thewholeworker stillrequiresd≥2.
declarations.statement_and_proof_assessment: Checkedchop/map bound andexistinglength_chop_le yieldpreparation≤(d²+4d+8)n+2. Actualn+1length/partition laws andbucketlength≤n yieldthedeclaredtariff. No abstractassumedcostlaw.
declarations.case_connection: Independentphasechecks covergroups2–6 andshortfinalgroups;thissamebound isused inallthree actualbranches.

theorem selectRunWith_cost_le_envelope_of_lt (d cutoff : Nat)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff) (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length) :
    (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc k xs).2 ≤ envelope d xs.length
declarations.statement_and_proof_assessment: Strongsizeinduction usesactualbaseentrybound, actualpositive/smaller median list, validmedianrank, actualpivotmembership andstrictside sizes. The selectedchildrank isprovedvalid. Existingtwo_child_budget_le consumesprovedlocalcharges; middlebranch useszero absentchildcost, neveranemptyselectioncall.

theorem selectRunWith_cost_le_envelope (d cutoff : Nat) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff)

theorem selectRunWith_uniform_prefix_bound (d cutoff : Nat)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff) (N : Nat) :
    ∀ (β : Type u) [LinearOrder β] (xs : List β) (k : Nat), xs.length ≤ N →
      (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc k xs).2 ≤ envelope d N
declarations.statement_and_proof_assessment: Actualallrankbound andexistingUmonotonicity. This providesauniformfinite-size prefixwithout takinga supremumoverinputs.

declarations.raw_header:
private theorem repeated_value_and_budget (d cutoff : Nat)
    (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff) :
    (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc 2 ([3, 1, 2, 2] : List Nat)).1 = some 2 ∧
      (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc 2 ([3, 1, 2, 2] : List Nat)).2 ≤ envelope d 4

theorem empty_any_group (d cutoff : Nat) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hc : 1 ≤ cutoff) (k : Nat) :
    selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc k ([] : List (Fin 0)) = (none, 2) ∧
      (selectRunWith d cutoff hd hc k ([] : List (Fin 0))).2 ≤ 4
